content: हा {%ind.%} A particle expressing .²1 Grief, dejection, pain, as expressed by ‘ah’, ‘alas!’, ‘woe me’, in <lang>English</lang>; हा प्रिये जानकि <ls>U. 3</ls>; हा हा देवि स्फुटति हृदयम् <ls>U. 3. 38</ls>; हा पितः क्वासि हे सुभ्रु <ls>Bk. 6. 11</ls>; हा वत्से मालति क्वासि <ls>Māl. 10</ls> <ab>&c.</ab>; (in this sense हा is often used with the <ab>acc.</ab> of person; हा कृष्णाभक्तम् <ls>Sk.</ls>). .²2 Surprise; हा कथं महाराजदशरथस्य धर्मदाराः प्रियसखी मे कौसल्या <ls>U. 4</ls>. .²3 Anger or reproach.

हा I. €3 <ab>Ā.</ab> (जिहीते, हान; {%<ab>pass.</ab>%} हायते; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} जिहासते) .²1 To go, move; जिहीथा विख्यातां स्फुटमिह भवद्बान्धवरथम् <ls>H. D. 28</ls>; <ls>Ki. 13. 23</ls>; <ls>Nalod. 1. 38</ls>. .²2 To get, attain. --II. €3 <ab>P.</ab> (जहाति, हीन) .²1 To leave, abandon, quit, give up, forsake, relinquish, dismiss; मूढ जहीहि धनागमतृष्णां कुरु तनुबुद्धे मनसि वितृष्णाम् <ls>Moha M. 1</ls>; सा स्त्रीस्वभावादसहा भरस्य तयोर्द्वयोरेकतरं जहाति <ls>Mu. 4. 13</ls>; <ls>R. 5. 72</ls>, <ls n="R.">8. 52</ls>, <ls n="R.">12. 24</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 61</ls>, <ls n="R. 14.">87</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 59</ls>; <ls>Ś. 4. 14</ls>; बुद्धियुक्तो जहातीह उभे सुकृतदुष्कृते <ls>Bg. 2. 50</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 53</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">5. 91</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">10. 71</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">20. 10</ls>; <ls>Me. 51</ls>, <ls n="Me.">62</ls>; <ls>Bv. 2. 129</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 1. 38</ls>. .²2 To resign, forego. .²3 To let fall. .²4 To omit, disregard, neglect. .²5 To remove. .²6 To avoid, shun. --{%<ab>Pass.</ab>%} (हीयते) .²1 To be left or forsaken; भिन्नतिमिरनिकरं न जहे शशिरश्मिसंगमयुजा नभः श्रिया <ls>Ki. 12. 12</ls>. .²2 To be excluded from, be deprived of, lose (with <ab>instr.</ab> or <ab>abl.</ab>); विरूपाक्षो जहे प्राणैः <ls>Bk. 14. 35</ls>; जनयित्वा सुतं तस्यां ब्राह्मण्यादेव हीयते <ls>Ms. 3. 17</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">5. 161</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">9. 211</ls>. .²3 To be deficient or wanting in; usually with परि <ab>q. v.</ab>; धैर्यं यस्य न हीयते <ls>Pt. 1. 103</ls>. .²4 To diminish, decrease, decay, decline, wane (<ab>fig.</ab> also); प्रवृद्धो हीयते चन्द्रः समुद्रोऽपि तथाविधः <ls>R. 17. 71</ls>; <ls>H. Pr. 42</ls>. .²5 To fail (as in a law-suit); भूतमप्यनुपन्यस्तं हीयते व्यवहारतः <ls>Y. 2. 19</ls>. .²6 To be left out or omitted. .²7 To be weakened. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (हापयति-ते) .²1 To cause to leave, abandon <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To drive away, expel. .²3 To lose. .²4 To neglect, omit, delay the performance of; द्रुतमेतु न हापयिष्यते सदृशं तस्य विधातुमुत्तरम् <ls>Śi. 16. 33</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 71</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">4. 21</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 121</ls>. --{%<ab>Desid.</ab>%} (जिहासति) To wish to leave <ab>&c.</ab>
